description: Diagnose IP duplication and rotation health per city to support carrier-switch and IP-pool decisions. Pair the Duplicate Rate (%) and Rotations/Phone/Day columns to classify the failure mode: high duplicates + low rotation = carrier broken (phones stuck on same IPs); high duplicates + high rotation = IP pool exhausted (carrier is rotating but recycling the same IPs across devices). Cities with fewer than 5 phones are excluded from the summary table to avoid single-phone outliers.

options.content:
**Goal:** spot cities with IP duplication problems and judge how aggressively phones are rotating.

**Read the two columns independently — they are NOT causally linked.**

**Duplicate Rate (%)**
- Tells you what fraction of phones in the city are currently sharing an IP with at least one other phone in the fleet.
- Higher = more collision exposure → higher detection / blocking risk.
- Threshold: 🟢 <10%, 🟡 10–25%, 🟠 25–40%, 🔴 >40%.
- Smoothed (+5 phantom healthy phones in denominator) so 1-phone cities don't falsely show 100%.

**Rotations / Phone / Day**
- Average IP changes per device per day, over the selected time range.
- High = phones cycling through fresh IPs frequently.
- Low = phones holding the same IP longer.
- A low number does NOT imply duplication, and a high number does NOT prevent duplication. Use it as a separate behavior signal.

**Suggested actions**
- High Duplicate Rate → investigate the IP pool the carrier is handing out for that city. Check the per-city detail below to see exactly which IPs and devices are colliding.
- Unexpectedly low Rotations / Phone / Day → confirm devices are actually requesting rotations and the carrier is honoring them.

**Filters:** City (multi-select, defaults to All), Proxy Status (Active by default). Time picker (top-right) applies to every panel.

panels.description: All metrics aggregated over the selected dashboard time range. Time filter applies to every column. Phones & rotations from proxy_requests_5min_summary (5-min aggregate, always fresh). Duplicate IPs from duplicate_ip_snapshot_rows (5-min snapshots, latest per day in window). Cities with fewer than 5 phones excluded. Click funnel icons to filter columns.

targets.rawSql:
WITH total_in_window AS (
  SELECT
    TRIM(p.city) AS city,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.proxy_id) AS total_phones
  FROM proxy_requests_5min_summary s
  JOIN proxies p ON s.proxy_id = p.device_id
  WHERE s.window_start BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND ('${proxy_status}' = 'all' OR p.proxy_status = '${proxy_status}')
    AND TRIM(p.city) != ''
  GROUP BY TRIM(p.city)
),
latest_per_day AS (
  SELECT DATE(captured_at) AS d, MAX(captured_at) AS max_ts
  FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_rows
  WHERE DATE(captured_at) BETWEEN DATE($__timeFrom()) AND DATE($__timeTo())
    AND proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_status}'
  GROUP BY DATE(captured_at)
),
dup_per_day_per_city AS (
  SELECT
    DATE(r.captured_at) AS d,
    SUBSTRING_INDEX(r.location, ',', 1) AS city,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.last_ip) AS dup_ips_day,
    SUM(r.phones_on_same_ip) AS phones_on_dups_day,
    MAX(r.phones_on_same_ip) AS max_phones_per_dup_day
  FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_rows r
  JOIN latest_per_day l ON r.captured_at = l.max_ts
  WHERE r.proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_status}'
    AND r.last_ip != '__snapshot_empty__'
    AND SUBSTRING_INDEX(r.location, ',', 1) != ''
  GROUP BY DATE(r.captured_at), SUBSTRING_INDEX(r.location, ',', 1)
),
dup_summary AS (
  SELECT
    city,
    ROUND(AVG(dup_ips_day)) AS avg_duplicate_ips,
    ROUND(AVG(phones_on_dups_day)) AS avg_phones_on_dups,
    MAX(max_phones_per_dup_day) AS max_phones_per_dup_ip
  FROM dup_per_day_per_city
  GROUP BY city
),
rotation_agg AS (
  SELECT
    TRIM(p.city) AS city,
    SUM(s.ip_change_count) AS total_rotations,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.proxy_id) AS phones_with_activity
  FROM proxy_requests_5min_summary s
  JOIN proxies p ON s.proxy_id = p.device_id
  WHERE s.window_start BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND TRIM(p.city) != ''
    AND ('${proxy_status}' = 'all' OR p.proxy_status = '${proxy_status}')
  GROUP BY TRIM(p.city)
)
SELECT
  t.city,
  t.total_phones,
  IFNULL(s.avg_phones_on_dups, 0) AS avg_phones_on_dup_ips,
  IFNULL(s.avg_duplicate_ips, 0) AS avg_duplicate_ips,
  ROUND(100.0 * IFNULL(s.avg_phones_on_dups, 0) / NULLIF(t.total_phones, 0), 1) AS duplicate_rate_pct,
  IFNULL(s.max_phones_per_dup_ip, 0) AS max_phones_per_dup_ip,
  ROUND(
    IFNULL(r.total_rotations, 0)
    / NULLIF(IFNULL(r.phones_with_activity, 0) * GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) / 86400.0, 1.0/1440.0), 0),
    2
  ) AS avg_rotations_per_phone_per_day
FROM total_in_window t
LEFT JOIN dup_summary s ON t.city = s.city
LEFT JOIN rotation_agg r ON t.city = r.city
WHERE t.total_phones >= 5
  AND ('${city:raw}' = '$__all' OR t.city IN (${city:sqlstring}))
ORDER BY duplicate_rate_pct DESC

panels.title: City Comparison — Duplicate IP & Rotation Summary

panels.description: Every duplicate IP from the latest snapshot within the selected time range. Source: duplicate_ip_snapshot_rows. The 'as_of' column shows the exact snapshot timestamp used. Click funnel icons to filter columns.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest_in_window AS (
  SELECT MAX(captured_at) AS latest_ts
  FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_rows
  WHERE DATE(captured_at) BETWEEN DATE($__timeFrom()) AND DATE($__timeTo())
    AND proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_status}'
)
SELECT
  SUBSTRING_INDEX(r.location, ',', 1) AS city,
  r.last_ip,
  r.phones_on_same_ip AS phones_sharing,
  r.all_servers_on_ip AS servers_sharing,
  r.sibling_phones AS all_phones_on_ip,
  r.device_ids,
  l.latest_ts AS as_of
FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_rows r
JOIN latest_in_window l ON r.captured_at = l.latest_ts
WHERE r.proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_status}'
  AND r.last_ip != '__snapshot_empty__'
  AND SUBSTRING_INDEX(r.location, ',', 1) != ''
  AND ('${city:raw}' = '$__all' OR SUBSTRING_INDEX(r.location, ',', 1) IN (${city:sqlstring}))
ORDER BY SUBSTRING_INDEX(r.location, ',', 1), r.phones_on_same_ip DESC

panels.title: Duplicate IPs — Per-City Detail (Latest Snapshot in Range)

panels.description: IP rotation events per city per 5-minute bucket over the selected time range. Source: proxy_requests_5min_summary. Each line = one city.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  s.window_start AS time,
  TRIM(p.city) AS city,
  SUM(s.ip_change_count) AS rotation_events
FROM proxy_requests_5min_summary s
JOIN proxies p ON s.proxy_id = p.device_id
WHERE s.window_start BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND ('${proxy_status}' = 'all' OR p.proxy_status = '${proxy_status}')
  AND TRIM(p.city) != ''
  AND ('${city:raw}' = '$__all' OR TRIM(p.city) IN (${city:sqlstring}))
GROUP BY s.window_start, TRIM(p.city)
ORDER BY time, city
